text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*.
Pardon me, that was quite unseemly."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, me winning is an absolute miracle.
Guess I gotta thank the gods above.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's win through pure skill so no one can doubt it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, that's not true!
Winning this time was probably just a fluke anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't really know if they're... strong or not.
But...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe once in a while I should just
dance along to Trainer's beat.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... Isn't that basically like
declaring, "I'm strong, you know"?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you lose after that, it's super,
super embarrassing.
choice_data_list: As long as I don't lose, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Waaow, you're really asking for the impossible!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can't be that confident just yet.
If only I could always race like I did today...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I was thinking... maybe it'd be okay to make a declaration...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Never mind, strike that!
Forget what I just said~!
